Reference / runtime/collections

runtime/collections#

The native layer under http/robots, http/routing: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under http/robots, http/routing: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Pure typed snapshot boundary, no environment/JSON conversion or I/O. Parallel string coordinates must have equal lengths and unique exact keys. Caller budgets are nonnegative, capped at4096 entries and1048576 Unicode scalars; limits charge key+value before publishing. Empty maps retain their exact string/string types. Inputs are unchanged; the resulting builtin map uses its existing deterministic lexical key order. Budget failures use resource_exhausted; malformed coordinates use invalid_input. Literal scalars plus '*' only; anchored=false accepts a matching prefix. Step budget 1..262144 counts pointer/retry iterations, including termination.
